text_block_list.name: Narration
text_block_list.text: On a sunny holiday, a matchmaking party hosted by the city hall was about to take place in a restaurant.
text_block_list.orig_text:
日差しの降り注ぐ休日のレストランで、
市役所主催の婚活パーティーが行われようとしていた。

text_block_list.name: Sono
text_block_list.text: Ehh... As for today's "Love Tsubakigaoka", thank you very much for joining us. I shall be your host, my name is Isurugi Sono, a city hall employee.
text_block_list.orig_text:
えー
本日は
「愛・
椿ヶ丘」にご参加いただき
ありがとうございます。
私司会を務めます、
市役所職員の石動苑と申しま──

text_block_list.name: Sono
text_block_list.text: Umhhhh...? I guess the weather's nice today, so there's only two participants...
text_block_list.orig_text:
えー……
本日はお日柄も良く、
参加者は
お二人ということでー……

text_block_list.name: Mitsuki
text_block_list.text: Ummm. We're here for a matchmaking party today, correct? It's being hosted by the city hall. I'm sure of it. I saw the poster and checked it over and over again before signing up. ...So, I wonder what's going on here...?
text_block_list.orig_text:
あの。
今日って、
婚活パーティーよね？　
市役所主催の。
間違いないわ。
ポスターを見て何度も確認してから申し込んだもの。
……いったい、
どういうことなのかしら……？

text_block_list.name: Sono
text_block_list.text: Um, about that... Y-You see, our sole male participant... He had an urgent matter to attend to, so... I'm sorry.
text_block_list.orig_text:
あの、
それがですね……
だ、
男性の参加者さまですが、
急用が
できた
とかで……
すみません。

text_block_list.name: Ruka
text_block_list.text: Ahaha, there's no need for you to apologize. Besides, to be honest, it's not like I was looking forward to matchmake with anyone.
text_block_list.orig_text:
はは、
アンタが謝ることじゃないよ。
それに、
正直
アタシは出会いなんて
別に求めてないしね。

text_block_list.name: Ruka
text_block_list.text: The husband of one of our regular customers works at the city hall, and she asked me to go because she thought there wouldn't be many participants.
text_block_list.orig_text:
うちのお得意さんの旦那さんが
市役所勤めでさ、
参加者少なそうだから行ってほしい
って
頼まれたんだ。

text_block_list.name: Mitsuki
text_block_list.text: Y-Yes. I-It's not like I had high hopes for this event, either. No, maybe I did, just a little... Like with my research, things don't go that smoothly in this sphere either. Yup...
text_block_list.orig_text:
え、
ええ。
私もそんなに期待はしてないけれど。
いえ、
もしかしたら
って
ちょっとは思ったわ……
研究と同じで、
そんなに順調にいくものじゃないわよ
ね。
ええ……

text_block_list.name: Sono
text_block_list.text: ...Um, I offer you my deepest apologies again. This event has failed to be a matchmaking party, so I'll just have to disband it. I'll report this to the city hall, so...
text_block_list.orig_text:
……あの、
本当に申し訳ございませんでした。
これ
婚活パーティーとして破綻してるので
解散しましょう。
市役所には報告をあげておくので。

text_block_list.name: Mitsuki
text_block_list.text: ...Hey, you two, do you have some free time after this? I know a good place nearby. Rather than going home feeling unsatisfied, why don't we let off some steam by going to a girls' get-together?
text_block_list.orig_text:
……ねえ。
あなたたち、
この後時間空いてるかしら。
この近くにいいお店を知ってるの。
不完全燃焼な気持ちで帰るくらいなら、
女子会で発散
といくのはどう？

text_block_list.name: Ruka
text_block_list.text: I'm up for that. Even if I go home, all that's left for me to do is some fishing. What about you, Isurugi-san?
text_block_list.orig_text:
アタシはいいよ。
帰っても
どうせ釣りくらいしかやることないしね。
石動さんは？

text_block_list.name: Sono
text_block_list.text: Ah, well, I should be catching up on some dramas that I've been putting off... No, actually, I'll join you since I've come all the way here.
text_block_list.orig_text:
ああ、
えーと
私は
とり溜めた
ドラマの消化を……
いえ、
せっかくなので
お付き合いさせていただきます。

text_block_list.name: Narration
text_block_list.text: A few hours later...
text_block_list.orig_text: 数時間後。

text_block_list.name: Sono
text_block_list.text: No, I mean... why should I, someone who's been forever single, try and help others to get married? ...Who would even benefit from some matchmaking party organized by the city? It's 100% better to leave this sort of thing to the private sector...
text_block_list.orig_text:
いや
なんで独身の私が
人の結婚の手伝いしなきゃなんないのよ。
……ってか
市が主催する婚活パーティーとか誰得？
こんなん民間に任せた方が100パーいいだろ……

text_block_list.name: Sono
text_block_list.text: It's fine if you get a plan approved to promote efforts to combat the declining birthrate. But if you came up with the idea, you should also be the one running it, you idiot boss. Why the hell am I the one getting dragged into this during a holiday?! Damn it, dammit, dammit~...!
text_block_list.orig_text:
少子化対策頑張ってますアピールの企画通すのは良いけどさ。
それなら立案したあんたが取り仕切れよ、
バカ上司。
何で私が休日に駆り出されてんのよ
クソクソクソクソ──

text_block_list.name: Sono
text_block_list.text: Huh?! I-I'm so sorry...! I had such a terrible slip of the tongue in front of our dear citizens...
text_block_list.orig_text:
はっ！？　
す、
すみません……！
市民の方の前で大変な失言を……

text_block_list.name: Ruka
text_block_list.text: Ahaha, it seems you've got a lot on your plate~ I don't mind at all. In fact, I like how much more human you sound after that.
text_block_list.orig_text:
あはは、
溜まってんね～
アタシは全然気にしない、
むしろ
人間味があって
好感が持てるよ。

text_block_list.name: Mitsuki
text_block_list.text: Hehe, detoxing a little is important every now and then, so I think it's fine. People who don't know the hardships that take place behind the scenes are everywhere. It's the same at our research institute... Oh, excuse me, that's my phone.
text_block_list.orig_text:
ふふ、
デトックスは大事だもの、
いいんじゃないかしら。
裏方の苦労を知らない人間はどこにでもいるものよね。
うちの研究所でも同じような……
っと、
ごめんなさい電話だわ。

text_block_list.name: Mitsuki
text_block_list.text: Yes, hello? ...Yes... Yes... The budget raise wasn't approved...? I see. We'll talk more on that later. Bye.
text_block_list.orig_text:
はい
もしもし。
……ええ……
ええ……
予算がおりない……？
そうですか。
その話はまた。
はい、
失礼します。

text_block_list.name: Mitsuki
text_block_list.text: ...Unbelievable, they don't understand ANYTHING...! I just did what I was told to do to hurry up, but now you want me to keep the budget as is and proceed? What would they ever know about what takes place in the lab~...?
text_block_list.orig_text:
……まったく、
何も分かってないんだから……！
急げっていうからその通りに対応しただけなのに、
予算はそのままで
進めてほしいだなんて、
現場のことをいったいなんだ──

text_block_list.name: Ruka
text_block_list.text: Whoa, someone else has steam to blow off too~ You two, make sure to go all out tonight!
text_block_list.orig_text:
おお、
こっちも溜まってんねぇ。
二人とも、
今日は
パーッといこう！

text_block_list.name: Ruka
text_block_list.text: But you know, it's been nothing but work complaints for a while now... Don't you have some other topic that comes to mind?
text_block_list.orig_text:
でもさ、
さっきから
仕事の愚痴ばっかだけど
その……
ちょっとは
浮いた話題とか
ないのかい？

text_block_list.name: Mitsuki
text_block_list.text: ...How about you?
text_block_list.orig_text: そういうあなたは？

text_block_list.name: Sono
text_block_list.text: Don't tell me... are we already past our prime?
text_block_list.orig_text:
……私ら
もしかして終わってます？

text_block_list.name: Ruka
text_block_list.text: ...We haven't even started yet.
text_block_list.orig_text: ……まだ始まってもいないよ。

text_block_list.name: Mitsuki
text_block_list.text: ...And that's exactly the problem here...
text_block_list.orig_text:
……始まってないのが問題、
なのよね……

text_block_list.name: The Three
text_block_list.text: ...Let's do our best.
text_block_list.orig_text: ……頑張ろ。

text_block_list.name: Narration
text_block_list.text: And so, after exchanging contact information, the three returned to their respective daily lives.
text_block_list.orig_text:
こうして連絡先を交換した３人は、
それぞれの日常へと帰るのだった。

text_block_list.name: Narration
text_block_list.text: ...Maybe they really were like that in a past life, too.
text_block_list.orig_text: ……なんて前世もあったのかもしれない。
